title: RNA-seq of human multiple myeloma patients myeloid-derived suppressor cells (M-MDSC)
description: The aim of this study is to evaluate prognostic impact of M-MDSCs (Myeloid-derived suppressor cells) in multiple myeloma (MM) remains in the context to autologous stem cell transplantation (ASCT).

samples.title: Sample 6
samples.description: Protocols: Blood samples for analysis of MDSC frequency were collected and pre- and post-ASCT. Pre-ASCT sampling was performed before conditioning chemotherapy. Post-ASCT sampling was performed one day after neutrophil engraftment, which was defined as the first of three consecutive days with ANC >0.5 × 10^9/L. The PBMCs were freshly isolated from whole blood (30 mL) and were processed immediately for flow cytometric analysis. RNA was harvested using Trizol reagent. Clontech SMART-Seq V4 Ultra low input RNA kit was used for sequencing. Illumina Nextera XT DNA sample preparation kit was used for the construction of sequencing libraries.
